lines.say: Your app has ten servers, and bots can't find a single one.
lines.show: Your app has *10 servers,* and bots [can't find a single one.]

lines.say: They scan the internet all night.
lines.show: They scan the internet all night.

lines.say: All they ever reach is one machine. Not your servers.
lines.show: All they ever reach is *one machine.* Not your servers.

lines.say: That machine is a reverse proxy: a middleman that every request hits first.
lines.show: That machine is a [reverse proxy:] a middleman that every request hits first.

lines.say: Like a restaurant. You never walk into the kitchen. The waiter takes your order and brings the food back.
lines.show: Like a *restaurant.* You never walk into the kitchen. The *waiter* takes your order and brings the food back.

lines.say: Your servers stay private, with no public address. Only the proxy faces the internet.
lines.show: Your servers stay *private,* with no public address. Only the proxy [faces the internet.]

lines.say: And this waiter does more than carry plates.
lines.show: And this waiter does more than carry plates.

lines.say: It keeps popular pages ready, so many requests never reach your servers.
lines.show: It keeps popular pages ready, so many requests [never reach your servers.]

lines.say: And it reads the address: slash API goes to these servers, images go to those.
lines.show: And it reads the address: */api* goes to these servers, *images* go to those.

lines.say: Engine X and Cloudflare do this for millions of websites.
lines.show: *NGINX* and *Cloudflare* do this for millions of websites.

lines.say: A forward proxy hides your IP address from the website. A reverse proxy hides the servers' addresses from you.
lines.show: A forward proxy hides *your IP address* from the website. A reverse proxy hides [the servers' addresses] from you.

lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
